metadata.name: GetLoyaltyProgramSegment
metadata.description: The Purpose of this API is to get the loyalty programwise summary of reward points in terms of Credit/Debit/Adjustments/Redemptions for timeperiod CurrentDay/Daily/Cycle/Monthly/Yearly/LifeTime.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder/AccountHolder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Condition:At least one of AccountNumber/AdminNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition:At least one of AccountNumber/AdminNumber is required.

request_fields.name: LoyaltyProgramID
request_fields.description: ID of Loyalty Program Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:2345(Value shared by Corecard).

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: LoyaltyProgramSegment
children.description: Array to show the details of rewards programwise.

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: MaskedCardNumber
children.description: Masked Card Number Valid Values:0-9 Example:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Allowable Values: 16

children.name: LoyaltyProgramName
children.description: Name of Loyalty Program Valid Values:A-Z,a-z Example: Card Loyalty Program Allowable Values: 20

children.name: CurrentBalance
children.description: Current balance of account/Debtor Owing Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX.XX Example:200.00

children.name: ProgramEndDate
children.description: End Date of Loyalty Program Valid Values:  0-9 Format: MMDDYYYY Example: 02012020

children.name: ProgramStartDate
children.description: Start Date of Loyalty Program Valid Values:  0-9 Format: MMDDYYYY Example: 02012020

children.name: BonusEndDate
children.description: Date when the Bonus reward period ended. Format:YYYYMMDDHHMMSS Example:202002041820

children.name: BonusStartDate
children.description: Date when the Bonus reward period ended. Format:YYYYMMDDHHMMSS Example:202002041820

children.name: FirstUsageBonus
children.description: Reward points earned within Bonus Period. Valid Values:0-9 Example:200

children.name: DayToDateBucket
children.description: Array to show Credit/Debit/Adjustment/Redemption buckets of rewards for a current day.

children.name: DebitsPoints
children.description: Total Reward points which got deducted within a time period. Valid Values:0-9 Example:100

children.name: DebitsCount
children.description: Number of transactions which deducted the reward points within a time period. Valid Values:0-9 Example:1

children.name: CreditsPoints
children.description: Total Reward points earned within a time period. Valid Values:0-9 Example:500

children.name: CreditsCount
children.description: Number of transactions which earned reward points within a time period. Valid Values:0-9 Example:2

children.name: DebitAdjustmentsPoints
children.description: Total Reward points deducted within the time period. Valid Values:0-9 Example:500

children.name: DebitAdjustmentsCount
children.description: Number of adjustment transactions which deducted the reward points within the time period. Valid Values:0-9 Example:500

children.name: CreditAdjustmentsPoints
children.description: Total Reward points deducted within the time period. Valid Values:0-9 Example:500

children.name: CreditAdjustmentsCount
children.description: Total Reward points earned with credit adjutsments within the time period. Valid Values:0-9 Example:500

children.name: RedemptionsPoints
children.description: Total Reward points redeemed within the time period. Valid Values:0-9 Example:500

children.name: RedemptionsCount
children.description: Number of  transactions posted to redeem the reward points within a time period. Valid Values:0-9 Example:500

children.name: RedemptionsReversalsPoints
children.description: Total Reward points which reversed after redemption within the time period. Valid Values:0-9 Example:500

children.name: RedemptionsReversalsCount
children.description: Number of reversal transactions posted to initiate reversal of  redeemed points within a time period. Valid Values:0-9 Example:500
